propositions: Cloud identifies users by opaque accountId while Data Center identifies them by name, and this distinction leaks into assignee resolution and payload shape without a pinned contract

PR #120 hardcoded is_account_id=False and consulted an unset _assignee_resolver attribute, making the authoritative branch unreachable and causing permanent non-authoritative DC assignee resolution that triggers unnecessary outbound diff churn

A UserIdentityModel protocol with resolve(local_value, remote_identity) and to_payload(value) methods must be implemented by AccountIdIdentity (Cloud) and NameIdentity (DC) to formalize the cloud/dc identity contract
NameIdentity must perform a real lookup against the DC user-search endpoint to return authoritative=True for resolvable assignees, enabling diff convergence and eliminating churn
Unresolvable assignees must raise BackendAssigneeNotFoundError rather than silently returning non-authoritative values for both implementations
